claims.text: Suspected CNS infection (bacterial or viral meningitis, encephalitis).
claims.quote: Suspected central nervous system (CNS) infection (acute bacterial meningitis, viral meningitis, encephalitis, subacute or chronic meningitis)

claims.text: Suspected subarachnoid hemorrhage not seen on neuroimaging, or when imaging isn't immediately available.
claims.quote: Suspected spontaneous subarachnoid hemorrhage not diagnosed on neuroimaging or if immediate neuroimaging is not available
Other CNS conditions, including Guillain-Barré syndrome, leptomeningeal metastases (carcinomatous meningitis), genetic metabolic encephalopathies

claims.text: Absolute contraindication: infection at or near the insertion site.
claims.quote: Suspected infection (eg, cellulitis, abscess) at or near the site of needle insertion

claims.text: CT or MRI first if there are focal deficits, altered mental status, papilledema or signs of herniation.
claims.quote: If there are suggestive findings (eg, focal neurologic deficits, altered mental status, papilledema, signs of herniation), do CT or MRI before lumbar puncture.

claims.text: Coagulopathy (eg, INR >1.5 including therapeutic anticoagulation, platelets < 50,000/mcL, or a raised aPTT) can lead to spinal hematoma; consider correcting it first.
claims.quote: Coagulopathy (eg, international normalized ratio [INR] >1.5, including therapeutic anticoagulation; thrombocytopenia [< 50,000/mcL, 50 × 109/L], or pathologically increased activated partial thromboplastin time), which can lead to spinal hematoma from lumbar puncture: Consider correcting prior to procedure.

claims.text: If the LP is delayed, treat suspected meningitis right away, after blood cultures.
claims.quote: When lumbar puncture is deferred, begin treatment of suspected acute bacterial meningitis or subarachnoid hemorrhage immediately. For suspected meningitis, do blood cultures prior to initiation of antibiotics.
Bacteremia has not been shown to predispose to meningitis after lumbar puncture and thus is not a contraindication.
